pUrvottaradinArdDayoH puRyatvaM vidaDatA vacanenArTAdrAtrO snAnadAnAdikaM pratiziDyate । evaM satyudayAnantaraBAvini dakziRAyane pUrvaBAge prASastyaM vADitvottaraBAge'nuzWAnaM Bavati ।
